D: A shy electronics store worker is pushed by his workmates into finally getting out there at 40.
P: Serve the snacks when Andy makes his famous egg salad sandwich.
S: Andy's careful morning routine, egg salad included

Jammy boiled eggs chopped with Japanese mayo, Dijon, chives and celery, piled thick on soft milk bread with crunchy lettuce and cracked pepper. Boil 8 eggs for 9 minutes, cool in iced water and peel. Chop roughly and fold with 100g Japanese mayonnaise, 2 tsp Dijon, 1 finely diced celery stick, 2 tbsp chives, salt and plenty of pepper. Butter 8 slices of soft milk bread. Lay iceberg lettuce on 4 slices, pile on the egg salad and close. Cut off the crusts, slice in half and press lightly.
Smart Tech poker night queso dip
poker night with the guys from Smart Tech

A hot, silky cheese dip of cheddar, chorizo, roasted capsicum and jalapeño, kept bubbling in a skillet, with corn chips and salted peanuts. Fry 1 diced chorizo until crisp. Add half a diced onion and 1 chopped jalapeño for 3 minutes. Stir in 1 tbsp cornflour, then 375ml evaporated milk, and simmer until it thickens. Over low heat, stir in 250g grated cheddar a handful at a time until smooth, then 80g chopped roasted capsicum and a pinch of cumin. Serve hot in a skillet with 250g corn chips and 150g salted peanuts.
M: dinner at Trish's with her kids

Whole chicken roasted over lemon, garlic and thyme until the skin crackles, with crispy potatoes, roast carrots and a punchy pan gravy. Heat the oven to 200C. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 30g soft butter, salt and pepper and stuff with 1 halved lemon, 4 garlic cloves and thyme. Toss 1kg potatoes and 4 carrots in chunks with oil and salt around it. Roast 1 hour 15 minutes, turning the vegetables once. Rest the chicken 10 minutes. Whisk 1 tbsp flour into the pan juices, add 300ml stock and simmer 3 minutes for gravy.
W: the speed dating night, three minutes a date

Rich dark chocolate ganache truffles rolled three ways, in cocoa, crushed hazelnuts and freeze-dried raspberry, with a pinch of flaky salt. Heat 120ml cream until just simmering and pour over 200g chopped dark chocolate. Stand 2 minutes, then stir until smooth with 20g butter and a pinch of salt. Chill 2 hours until firm. Scoop into 20 balls and roll quickly in your hands. Roll a third in cocoa, a third in 40g crushed toasted hazelnuts and a third in crushed freeze-dried raspberries. Chill until serving.
K: Andy's careful routine, and his action figure collection

Chocolate ice cream blended with cold milk and malted milk powder until thick, served in a tall glass with whipped cream and crushed malt balls. Blend 500g chocolate ice cream, 400ml cold milk and 3 tbsp malted milk powder until thick and smooth. Pour into 4 tall chilled glasses. Whip 100ml cream to soft peaks and spoon on top. Crush 60g chocolate malt balls and scatter over. Serve with straws.
